title: NetworkFollowDeletedPayload
description: network.follow.deleted v1 (OpenVibe.Network; roadmap WS-E task 4, ADR-030). A person stopped following something (or the follow went with an account). Written to Network's outbox in the transaction that removes the follow; unfollowing what is not followed sends nothing. A consumer applies the latest revision per (follower, target). Envelope: subject { type: user, id: <follower> }, visibility subject, actor the follower (system:network for an account removal).
